title: A ratchet refuses a new raw git fixture outside internal/gittest (116 remain after cycle 1706's instance fix)
summary: Cycle 1706 closed a flake-class ticket by migrating the three sighted tests; 116 test files still build raw git repositories in t.TempDir() exposed to the same unlinkat flake, and nothing stops a new one. Design doc §7.9 G3.
